summary: Submitted 5 attempts. The main code finding is in the inventory module: ensureInventoryLevels checks each reservation entry against available quantity on its own and never sums entries that share an inventory item (per-line-check). Attempt 1 tests it with a single cart mixing OVS-PIECE x6 and OVS-TWOPACK x3, which needs 12 WIDGET units against a stock of 10. Attempts 2 and 3 target the in-memory lock being process-local across two servers. Attempt 4 targets the stale reserved_quantity write, and attempt 5 repeats a same-cart completion on one server. None of the results were shown, so I'm claiming only attempt 1.
